recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It fixes the remaining core narrative ambiguity from FHIR-16243 while preserving the later itemWeight naming and Extension Pack ownership. Future itemWeight context changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack and coordinated with FHIR-I/SDC decisions such as FHIR-49854.
issue_request: FHIR-16243 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core STU3 Questionnaire request to let the scoring/ordinalValue extension cover all answer value types, not just codes, by changing the ordinalValue context from valueCoding to value.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by svn revision 14123, represented as git commit 449e48ec1c9021a078d61afe87b901dabd5f2ec4, which changed the old ordinal-value extension context from coded-specific locations including Questionnaire.item.answerOption.valueCoding to Any and changed code wording to concept wording. Later refactoring removed that old core extension row, but the current Questionnaire math note still described itemWeight as for coded answers.
additional_context: Later published issues consolidated and renamed the extension family: FHIR-17350/FHIR-17824 rationalized ordinal extensions, FHIR-24672 renamed ordinalValue to itemWeight, and the active itemWeight definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack. Current Extension Pack source has Questionnaire.item.answerOption as the itemWeight context, and FHIR-49854 later clarified that questionnaire itemWeight goes on answerOption rather than answerOption.valueCoding.
reconciliation: Updated source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml in the active Questionnaire resource notes to say itemWeight can be used on Questionnaire.item.answerOption for inline answer choices, including when the option value is not a code. No core extension-definition source was edited because the authoritative itemWeight and retired ordinalValue definitions are in the FHIR Extension Pack and already carry the broader context.
source_changes: source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml: changed the Questionnaire math note from coded-answer/code-only wording to answerOption wording that explicitly includes non-code option values.

related_jiras.note: Later STU3 decision consolidated duplicate ordinal scoring extensions, explaining why the original iso21090 ordinal-value target is no longer current.
Renamed ordinalValue to itemWeight for R5, explaining the current extension name and link.
FHIR-extensions clarification added text that itemWeight goes on Questionnaire.item.answerOption rather than answerOption.valueCoding.
Moved CodeSystem and ValueSet item weighting to the itemWeight concept property, so this reconciliation stayed focused on inline Questionnaire answerOption use.
